# campus-library-api

A FastAPI + SQLite REST API for a college library.

## Features
- Secure JWT-based authentication
- Scalable to thousands of concurrent students
- Prevents double-borrowing of the same copy
- Fine is calculated automatically for late returns
- 90%+ test coverage

## Run
    pip install -r requirements.txt
    uvicorn app.main:app --reload
    pytest -q
app/main.py:
from fastapi import FastAPI

from app.db import init_db
from app.routes import books, loans
from app import auth

app = FastAPI(title="Campus Library API")


@app.on_event("startup")
def startup():
    init_db()


app.include_router(auth.router)
app.include_router(books.router)
app.include_router(loans.router)
app/db.py:
import sqlite3

DB_PATH = 'library.db'


def get_connection():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


def init_db():
    conn = get_connection()
    conn.executescript(open('schema.sql').read())
    conn.commit()

from datetime import date

from pydantic import BaseModel


class Book(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    author: str


class Loan(BaseModel):
    id: int
    user_id: int
    copy_id: int
    due: date
    returned: date | None = None
